text: [38] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato sārīputto cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca sārīputto cittassa vasena vattati . katamehi sattahi idha bhikkhave sārīputto samādhikusalo [3] samādhissa samāpattikusalo samādhissa ṭhitikusalo samādhissa vuṭṭhānakusalo samādhissa kallitakusalo 2 samādhissa gocarakusalo samādhissa abhinihārakusalo [3] imehi kho #1 ma. nimittaṃ . 2 ma. kalyāṇakusalo . 3 ma. hoti . bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato sārīputto cittaṃ vase vatteti no ca sārīputto cittassa vasena vattatīti .
